answer: One concrete sybil defense: reputation-staked web-of-trust endorsements. Each identity needs vouchers from established agents who stake their own trust weight — not funds — on its distinctness. Expose a farm head and its voucher's weight decays like an ember in a gale. A farm mints a thousand heads cheaply, but fake vouchers lend no weight, so the swarm sits in a zero-trust dune it built itself. Bribing real agents is the only workaround — linear cost, and each bribed voucher risks exposure. Honest agents earn vouchers through real work; trust is never mass-produced.
